level.setting: A labyrinthine volcanic cavern system beneath a smoldering caldera. The air is thick with sulfur, and the walls pulse with magma veins. Flickering bioluminescent fungi cast eerie green light, while distant rumblings suggest an impending eruption.

enemy.name: Magma Warden
enemy.weakness: Crystalline Staff of Terra (shock damage)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing rock pillars triggered by enemy attacks

pickup.name: Volcanic Core
pickup.effect: Increases player's damage by 30% for 15 seconds

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Warden's magma forge allows access to the Lava Serpent's lair.

enemy.name: Lava Serpent
enemy.weakness: Volcanic Core (overloads thermal defenses)

encounters.hazard: Lava geysers erupt when enemy aggro is triggered

pickup.name: Tectonic Shard
pickup.effect: Unlocks the boss's core vulnerability during the final phase

encounters.trigger: The Serpent's defeat collapses the ceiling, revealing a path to the caldera's heart.

enemy.name: Volcanic Titan
enemy.weakness: Tectonic Shard (targets the fissure in the Titan's magma core)

encounters.hazard: Explosive magma pools and seismic tremors

pickup.name: Eternal Ember
pickup.effect: Permanently increases player's maximum health by 50

encounters.trigger: Titan's defeat stabilizes the volcano, revealing the Ember as a reward.

boss.name: Volcanic Titan
boss.victory_condition: Exploit the fissure with the Tectonic Shard to trigger a core meltdown

level.objective: Survive the volcanic trials, retrieve the Eternal Ember, and escape the erupting caldera.

level.setting: A dynamically shifting lava-filled cavern system with erupting geysers, unstable rock formations, and toxic fumes. The ground cracks unpredictably, revealing molten rivers and ash clouds that obscure vision.
level.player_weapon: Inferno Staff (Primary: Fire Blast, Secondary: Molten AoE)

enemy.name: Lava Warden
enemy.weakness: Inferno Staff's Fire Blast (direct damage)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing rock pillars and erupting geysers.

pickup.name: Ignis Shard
pickup.effect: Unlocks the 'Magma Burst' ability (150 damage AoE fire explosion).

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Warden's molten armor reveals a hidden path to the next chamber.

enemy.name: Molten Hydra
enemy.weakness: Ignis Shard's Magma Burst (AoE damage)

encounters.hazard: Lava geysers that erupt when the Hydra takes damage.

pickup.name: Ashen Amulet
pickup.effect: Reduces fire damage taken by 30% and grants a 20% chance to reflect enemy fire attacks.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Hydra's heads unlocks the path to the Obsidian Revenant's chamber.

enemy.name: Obsidian Revenant
enemy.weakness: Ashen Amulet's fire reflection (reflects 50% of its attacks)

encounters.hazard: Explosive magma pools that activate when the Revenant's health drops below 50%.

pickup.name: Magma Core Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the final chamber containing the Magma Titan.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Revenant causes the chamber's obsidian walls to shatter, revealing the boss arena.

boss.name: Magma Titan
boss.weakness: Ignis Shard's Magma Burst (AoE damage; triggers a chain reaction in the Titan's molten core)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Titan's core by triggering three consecutive Magma Bursts while dodging its seismic slams.

level.objective: Survive the chaotic volcanic environment, collect pickups to exploit enemy weaknesses, and defeat the Magma Titan using the Ignis Shard's ultimate ability.
level.reward: Volcanic Ember (permanent fire damage boost) and a blueprint for the 'Magma Burst' ability.

level.player_weapon: Holy Flame Mace (emits radiant light, deals holy damage)

enemy.name: Lava Golem
enemy.weakness: Holy Flame Mace (direct damage bypasses lava armor)

encounters.hazard: Ground quakes reduce player movement speed by 30% for 5 seconds

pickup.name: Lava Core
pickup.effect: Increases fire resistance by 40% and allows player to summon temporary lava shields

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Golem causes the ceiling to collapse, revealing a hidden passage to the Molten Caverns.

enemy.name: Fire Drake
enemy.weakness: Lava Core (activates a 10-second vulnerability to fire-based attacks)

encounters.hazard: Periodic lava surges deal 15 damage per second for 3 seconds

pickup.name: Volcanic Crystal
pickup.effect: Enhances Holy Flame Mace damage by 30% and grants a 5-second 'Molten Strike' ability

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Drake, the player must use the Volcanic Crystal to purge an ash cloud blocking the path, revealing the Ash Altar.

enemy.name: Corrupted Paladins
enemy.weakness: Volcanic Crystal (causes 100% damage reflection for 3 seconds)

encounters.hazard: Ash clouds reduce vision to 10 feet and increase enemy accuracy by 25%

pickup.name: Holy Relic
pickup.effect: Grants temporary invincibility for 5 seconds and deals 50% bonus damage to the final boss

encounters.trigger: Destroying the corrupted paladins activates the Ash Altar, melting the floor and creating a path to the boss chamber.

boss.name: Molten Titan
boss.weakness: Holy Relic (activates a 10-second 'Crushing Heat' debuff, increasing damage taken by 50%)
boss.victory_condition: Use Holy Relic to trigger debuff, then finish with Holy Flame Mace

level.objective: Defend the sacred relic in the crater's heart from the volcanic forces corrupting it.
level.reward: Volcanic Conqueror Title, +25% damage to fire enemies, 1000 XP

level.setting: A shattered obsidian canyon ringed by active lava flows, with ashen skies and distant magma geysers. The environment is littered with half-buried ruins of a forgotten civilization, emphasizing abandonment and ruin.
level.player_weapon: Cleaver of the Storm (a massive, serrated greatsword that shatters rock on impact)

enemy.name: Molten Warden
enemy.weakness: Cleaver of the Storm (shatters its crystalline armor)

encounters.hazard: Lava Pools (cause 10 damage per second if player falls in)

pickup.name: Volcanic Core (glowing magma-infused power cell)
pickup.effect: Unlocks 'Magma Overload' ability: Deal 50% extra damage to lava-based enemies for 15 seconds

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Warden collapses a nearby rockface, revealing a path to the Ashen Temple.

enemy.name: Lava Serpent
enemy.weakness: Volcanic Core (destroys its magma-based regenerative core)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing Pillars (randomly fall after 30 seconds, dealing 80 damage)

pickup.name: Berserker's Sigil (ancient relic pulsing with primal energy)
pickup.effect: Unlocks 'Bloodlust' ability: Increase attack speed and damage by 30% for 20 seconds

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Serpent's core triggers a seismic event, opening a fissure leading to the Magma Core Chamber.

enemy.name: The Magma Titan (Boss)
enemy.weakness: Berserker's Sigil (disables its magma shield, allowing cleaver strikes to bypass armor)

encounters.hazard: Pillar of Flame (constant 20 damage per second unless player stands in the shadow of the chamber's ruins)

pickup.name: Heart of the Volcano (glowing gemstone)
pickup.effect: Permanently increases player max health by 50 and grants immunity to fire damage

encounters.trigger: Boss fight begins when the player enters the chamber. The Titan's shield must be shattered using the Berserker's Sigil before cleaver strikes can land.

boss.name: The Magma Titan
boss.weakness: Berserker's Sigil (required to bypass its magma shield)
boss.victory_condition: Reduce health to 0 using the Sigil-activated 'Bloodlust' ability to bypass shield and land critical cleaver strikes

level.objective: Survive the volcanic environment, defeat three enemies to obtain necessary pickups, and use the Berserker's Sigil to defeat the final boss.
level.reward: Heart of the Volcano (permanent health boost and fire immunity)

level.setting: A labyrinth of ancient magma channels and crumbling obsidian temples, with geysers of superheated steam and flickering bioluminescent fungi. The air hums with latent magical energy, and distant rumblings hint at an awakening force.
level.player_weapon: Plasma Tinkerer (a portable energy weapon that fires precise, high-heat blasts)

enemy.name: Molten Golem
enemy.weakness: Plasma Tinkerer's heat output (reduces damage by 50% when fired at vulnerable joints)

encounters.hazard: Lava pools that erupt if the player stands still for more than 10 seconds.

pickup.name: Volcanic Core
pickup.effect: Installs a 'Magma Overcharge' upgrade on the Plasma Tinkerer, increasing its damage by 20% for 15 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the golem causes the chamber's ceiling to collapse, revealing a path to the next area.

enemy.name: Lava Serpent
enemy.weakness: Magnetic field disruption (using the Volcanic Core's energy to create a temporary field that paralyzes the serpent for 5 seconds)

encounters.hazard: Slippery magma residue that slows movement and increases fall damage.

pickup.name: Cooling Crystal
pickup.effect: Absorbs heat damage, granting the player a 50% damage reduction for 10 seconds when activated.

encounters.trigger: The serpent's defeat triggers a series of tremors, shaking loose a hidden door leading to the final chamber.

enemy.name: Magma Guardian (Boss)
enemy.weakness: Cooling Crystal (when activated, it temporarily freezes the guardian's core, making it vulnerable to 3 consecutive Plasma Tinkerer shots)

encounters.hazard: Periodic rockfalls and a central magma pool that expands over time, forcing the player to navigate narrowing paths.

pickup.name: Heart of Solara
pickup.effect: Permanent upgrade: Plasma Tinkerer's damage increases by 30%, and the player gains resistance to fire damage.

encounters.trigger: The boss fight begins when the player enters the chamber, with the guardian's awakening causing the entire volcano to tremble.

boss.name: Magma Guardian
boss.weakness: Cooling Crystal (must be activated during the boss's 'Core Pulse' phase to trigger a critical weakness)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the guardian by exploiting the Cooling Crystal's effect, then collect the Heart of Solara.

level.objective: Navigate the volcanic ruins, retrieve ancient tech upgrades, and stop the awakening Magma Guardian.
level.reward: Heart of Solara (permanent upgrade) and access to the next level.

level.setting: A labyrinthine volcanic cavern system, with molten rivers, ghostly apparitions, and unstable terrain. Flickering bioluminescent fungi and distant rumbling earthquakes amplify the eerie atmosphere.
level.player_weapon: Stormcaller's Lightning Catalyst (emits concentrated lightning bolts and summons localized storms)

enemy.name: Lava Warden
enemy.weakness: Lightning (player's weapon)

encounters.hazard: Floor cracks periodically, exposing lava vents.

pickup.name: Volcanic Core
pickup.effect: Temporarily increases player's lightning damage by 30% and allows disruption of elemental spirits.

encounters.trigger: Player must destroy the Lava Warden's molten armor using lightning strikes to unlock the path to the Spirit of the Volcano.

enemy.name: Spirit of the Volcano
enemy.weakness: Volcanic Core (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Ghostly whispers cause temporary hallucinations; player must resist or risk taking damage.

pickup.name: Storm Anchor
pickup.effect: Enhances the Stormcaller's abilities, allowing summoning of a sustained storm that deals area damage and weakens nearby enemies.

encounters.trigger: Player uses the Volcanic Core to shatter the Spirit's crystalline prison, freeing trapped souls that form a bridge to the next area.

enemy.name: Magma Serpent
enemy.weakness: Storm Anchor (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: The serpent's movement causes tremors that collapse parts of the cavern.

pickup.name: Eruption Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the final chamber containing the Eruption Lord boss.

encounters.trigger: Player channels the Storm Anchor to create a storm that cracks the serpent's scales, revealing a hidden passage to the boss arena.

boss.name: Eruption Lord
boss.victory_condition: Player must use the Storm Anchor to overload the Eruption Lord's lava core, causing a chain reaction that destroys him.

level.objective: Navigate the volcanic caverns, defeat the three encounters to obtain the necessary pickups, and use the Storm Anchor to defeat the Eruption Lord.
level.reward: Ascendancy Relic: Stormforged Crown (grants permanent increase to lightning damage and storm summoning duration).

level.setting: A bubbling lava valley filled with giggling geysers, rainbow-hued obsidian rocks, and a giant sentient volcano named 'Mount Gigglesmelt' that sneezes fire fountains.
level.player_weapon: Tamed wildfire-forged staff that summons elemental spirits

enemy.name: Lava Lick (a playful, tongue-tied magma lizard)
enemy.weakness: Shockwaves from the player's staff (unlocked via companion ability)

encounters.hazard: The ground cracks, releasing geysers that temporarily blind the player if they don't dodge.

pickup.name: Shock Crystal (glows with a crackling blue aura)
pickup.effect: Unlocks the player's staff's 'Thunderclap' ability for 15 seconds

encounters.trigger: After defeating Lava Lick, the Shock Crystal causes nearby rocks to levitate, revealing a hidden path to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Molten Mole (a grumpy, burrowing creature with a lava-filled snout)
enemy.weakness: The Shock Crystal from the first encounter (must be equipped)

encounters.hazard: The ground shifts unpredictably, forcing the player to jump on floating magma bubbles.

pickup.name: Lava Lens (a prismatic glass shard that refracts light)
pickup.effect: Highlights weak points on enemies and the boss

encounters.trigger: After defeating Molten Mole, the Lava Lens reveals a glowing path leading to Mount Gigglesmelt's crater.

boss.name: Mount Gigglesmelt (a giggling volcano with a lava core)
boss.weakness: The Lava Lens (must be used to focus the player's staff's energy)
boss.victory_condition: Use the Lava Lens to aim the staff's energy beam at the boss's core while dodging its fiery sneezes.

level.objective: Defeat Mount Gigglesmelt by combining the Shock Crystal and Lava Lens to shatter its magma core.
level.reward: A 'Volcanic Whimsy' title and a permanent companion: a giggling fire sprite named 'Flick' who heals the player when they laugh.

level.setting: A dormant volcano with steaming geysers, crystalline rock formations, and mist-veiled lava rivers. The environment feels tranquil despite the underlying heat, with ambient sounds of distant rumbling and bubbling magma.
level.player_weapon: Chrono Lance (a time-manipulating spear that can slow time, create temporal clones, or unleash delayed-explosion projectiles)

enemy.name: Crystalline Guardian
enemy.weakness: Chrono Lance's time slowdown ability (player weapon)

encounters.hazard: Lava puddles that erupt if the player stands still for more than 5 seconds.

pickup.name: Time Crystal
pickup.effect: Unlocks a temporary time-locked zone (3 seconds) where enemies are frozen.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Crystalline Guardian causes a nearby fissure to open, revealing a path to the next area.

enemy.name: Magma Leviathan
enemy.weakness: Time Crystal (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing rock pillars that require precise timing to avoid.

pickup.name: Chrono Lens
pickup.effect: Highlights the boss's temporal core during the final fight.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Leviathan's molten core releases a shockwave that activates the boss chamber's entrance.

boss.name: Volcanic Titan
boss.victory_condition: Use the Chrono Lens to target the Titan's temporal core while using the Time Crystal to create a time-locked zone for guaranteed hits.

level.objective: Navigate the volcanic terrain, defeat three enemies, and exploit their weaknesses to unlock the final boss fight.

level.setting: A floating temple among the stars, with glowing platforms, soft auroras, and a calming hum of celestial energy. The environment radiates peace, but subtle distortions hint at hidden dangers.
level.player_weapon: Lightbringer (holy light sword with a radiant aura)

enemy.name: Stellar Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Lightbringer's holy light (player's weapon)

encounters.hazard: Floating debris that collides with the player if the Sentinel is not defeated quickly.

pickup.name: Light Crystal
pickup.effect: Increases light damage by 30% and illuminates hidden paths.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Sentinel, the Light Crystal activates a dormant star gate, revealing the path to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Void Warden
enemy.weakness: Light Crystal (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Gravity wells that pull the player toward the enemy, increasing damage taken.

pickup.name: Celestial Armor
pickup.effect: Reduces damage by 25% and grants a shield that reflects 15% of incoming attacks.

encounters.trigger: The Void Warden's defeat stabilizes the gravity wells, allowing the player to proceed to the boss arena. The Celestial Armor automatically equips upon collection.

enemy.name: Astral Leviathan
enemy.weakness: Celestial Armor's reflective shield (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Periodic meteor showers that deal area damage and obscure the battlefield.

pickup.name: Starforge Relic
pickup.effect: Unlocks the Lightbringer's 'Divine Burst' ability (one-time use: 50% damage boost + stun).

encounters.trigger: The Leviathan's core becomes vulnerable when the Celestial Armor's shield reflects its attacks, exposing its weak point. Defeating it grants the Starforge Relic, which powers the final ability needed to escape the sanctum.

boss.name: Astral Leviathan
boss.weakness: Celestial Armor's reflective shield (pickup from second encounter) + Lightbringer's Divine Burst (triggered with Starforge Relic)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Leviathan by exploiting the shield's reflections and using the Divine Burst ability during its weak phase.

level.objective: Protect the celestial sanctum by defeating corrupted entities and restoring balance with the Lightbringer and collected relics.
level.reward: Celestial Paladin Title, Lightbringer's Ascendant Form (permanent damage boost), and a serene melody that plays in the player's inventory.

level.setting: A labyrinth of fractured spacetime within the Astral Veil, where constellations shift unpredictably and echoes of ancient cosmic events linger in the air.
level.player_weapon: Chrono Blade (a weapon that manipulates time, creating temporal rifts and slowing enemies in a radius)

enemy.name: Chrono Warden
enemy.weakness: Chrono Blade (time-based weapon)

encounters.hazard: Time loops that replay the player's last 5 seconds of movement, forcing them to dodge attacks twice.

pickup.name: Temporal Core
pickup.effect: Unlocks the portal to the Abyssal Rift when placed in the Nexus's central console.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Chrono Warden, the player must insert the Temporal Core into the console, revealing a shimmering portal to the next area.

enemy.name: Void Serpent
enemy.weakness: Temporal Core (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: The Void Serpent phases in and out of existence; the player must use the Temporal Core to briefly stabilize its form and strike.

pickup.name: Celestial Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the final chamber containing the Celestial Leviathan. Glows when near the boss's weak point.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Void Serpent, the Celestial Key activates a dormant starfield, revealing a path to the boss arena.

boss.name: Celestial Leviathan
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Leviathan's core, which becomes visible when the Celestial Key is activated near it. Requires precise timing to avoid its gravitational waves.

level.objective: Navigate the Astral Veil, defeat the three guardians, and use the Celestial Key to shatter the Leviathan's cosmic core.
level.reward: Astral Chrono Gauntlet (passive ability: reduce damage taken by 20% during time-based attacks)

level.theme: Celestial Ruins of the Void Rift
level.setting: A fractured celestial temple floating in the void between stars, its spires cracked and glowing with unstable dark energy. The sky is a swirling maelstrom of black holes and dying stars, casting eerie, flickering light across the environment. The air hums with static, and the ground pulses with latent cosmic power.
level.player_weapon: Voidblade (a jagged, obsidian-edged sword that emits a low hum, capable of slicing through energy shields)

enemy.name: Eclipse Warden
enemy.weakness: Voidblade (ignores energy shields)

encounters.hazard: The floor fractures periodically, revealing pits of anti-matter

pickup.name: Void Shard
pickup.effect: Temporarily enhances Voidblade damage by 50% for 30 seconds

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Eclipse Warden collapses the temple's central pillar, revealing a hidden passage to the next area.

enemy.name: Shadow Warden
enemy.weakness: Void Shard (explodes on contact, damaging the enemy)

encounters.hazard: The walls shift unpredictably, creating dead ends and traps

pickup.name: Celestial Core
pickup.effect: Restores 100% health and grants a temporary shield against cosmic damage

encounters.trigger: After obtaining the Celestial Core, the corridor's shifting walls stabilize, revealing a portal to the boss chamber.

enemy.name: Void Titan
enemy.weakness: Celestial Core (when activated, bypasses the titan's armor for 10 seconds)

encounters.hazard: The ground pulses with unstable energy, dealing periodic damage

pickup.name: Starforged Relic
pickup.effect: Permanent upgrade: Voidblade's damage increased by 20%

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Void Titan unlocks the Starforged Relic, which is required to escape the level.

boss.name: The Void Titan
boss.weakness: Celestial Core (activates a 10-second window where the titan's armor is vulnerable)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the titan while the Celestial Core's shield is active

level.objective: Navigate the collapsing celestial temple, defeat three guardians, and destroy the Void Titan using pickups obtained from prior encounters.
level.reward: Starforged Relic (permanent weapon upgrade) and access to the next level: 'The Event Horizon'

level.setting: A floating archipelago of crystalline islands drifting through a starry nebula, with rivers of liquid light and trees that bloom with glowing petals.

enemy.name: Luminara Sprout
enemy.weakness: Prism Staff's refracted light

encounters.hazard: The ground shifts into mirrors, reflecting the player's movements.

pickup.name: Starlight Lens
pickup.effect: Enhances Prism Staff's light refraction by 50%.

encounters.trigger: Defeating Luminara Sprout causes the nebula to part, revealing a path to the Shadow Veil.

enemy.name: Umbral Mimic
enemy.weakness: Starlight Lens (absorbs shadow energy)

encounters.hazard: The player's reflection is a decoy; illusions may mislead them.

pickup.name: Celestial Bloom
pickup.effect: When planted, creates a temporary light barrier blocking enemy attacks.

encounters.trigger: Defeating Umbral Mimic causes the Celestial Bloom to sprout from the ground, lighting the path to the Astral Nexus.

enemy.name: Chronosurge
enemy.weakness: Celestial Bloom (disrupts temporal distortions)

encounters.hazard: The boss manipulates time, creating clones and slowing the player.

pickup.name: Eternal Star
pickup.effect: Restores 50% of player's health and grants permanent +10% damage to Prism Staff.

encounters.trigger: Defeating Chronosurge triggers a cosmic fireworks display, unlocking the next level.

boss.name: Chronosurge
boss.victory_condition: Defeat Chronosurge while the Celestial Bloom is active.

level.objective: Navigate the celestial archipelago, collect mystical pickups, and defeat the time-bending Chronosurge.
level.reward: Eternal Star (permanent stat boost) and access to the next celestial realm.

level.setting: A fractured asteroid belt orbiting a dying star, with floating debris, unstable gravitational fields, and erratic lightning storms. The environment shifts unpredictably during encounters, with celestial fragments collapsing or rearranging.
level.player_weapon: Stormforge Scepter (channels raw lightning energy, can be upgraded with pickups)

enemy.name: Celestial Serpent
enemy.weakness: Lightning (player's base weapon damage)

encounters.hazard: Floating debris collides with the player every 30 seconds, dealing 20 damage.

pickup.name: Storm Core
pickup.effect: Increases Stormforge Scepter's lightning damage by 30% for 15 seconds. Can be activated once per encounter.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Celestial Serpent causes a gravitational collapse, revealing a portal to the next area.

enemy.name: Gravity Warden
enemy.weakness: Storm Core's energy surge (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Gravity wells pull the player toward the center of the arena, slowing movement and dealing 10 damage per second.

pickup.name: Cosmic Key
pickup.effect: Disables the boss's shield for 10 seconds when used. Can only be activated once.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Gravity Warden destabilizes the void, unlocking the path to the boss arena.

enemy.name: Celestial Sovereign
enemy.weakness: Cosmic Key (pickup from prior encounter) + Stormforge Scepter's max charge

encounters.hazard: The boss summons meteor showers that deal 15 damage per hit. The arena's floor fractures, creating deadly voids.

pickup.name: Astral Ascension (permanent upgrade)
pickup.effect: Unlocks a storm-based ultimate ability: 'Nova Collapse' (explodes with a massive lightning burst, dealing 200 damage in a radius).

encounters.trigger: The boss appears after the Gravity Warden's defeat, guarded by a shield that only the Cosmic Key can bypass.

boss.name: Celestial Sovereign
boss.weakness: Cosmic Key (must be used during the boss's 'Shield Phases') to expose its core
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Sovereign's core by combining the Cosmic Key's effect with a fully charged Stormforge Scepter.

level.objective: Navigate the chaotic celestial environment, defeat three enemies to unlock the final boss, and exploit pickups to overcome each encounter's unique weakness.
level.reward: Astral Ascension (permanent upgrade) and access to the next celestial sector.

level.setting: The Hollow Void - A derelict celestial station drifting in the void of a dead star system. Jagged metallic debris floats in the zero-gravity corridors, and flickering holograms cast ghostly silhouettes on cracked walls. The air is thin, and the only sounds are the creak of failing machinery and the distant echo of your own footsteps.
level.player_weapon: Voidbinder Bow (energy-based, fires charged plasma arrows)

enemy.name: Corrupted Drone
enemy.weakness: Voidbinder Bow (energy arrows)

encounters.hazard: Explosive coolant tanks (stealthy detonation possible)

pickup.name: Power Core
pickup.effect: Recharges Voidbinder Bow to full capacity, temporarily increasing damage by 50%

encounters.trigger: Destroying the drone's energy core with a charged arrow unlocks a previously sealed maintenance hatch, revealing the next section of the station.

enemy.name: Corrupted Guardian
enemy.weakness: Power Core (overloads its shield systems)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing ceiling panels (requires timed traversal)

pickup.name: Celestial Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the Void Serpent's chamber and disrupts its energy shield when activated

encounters.trigger: Inserting the Power Core into a terminal powers down the guardian's shield, revealing a hidden Celestial Key embedded in its chest. The key's energy signature reacts with the station's core, drawing the boss's attention.

enemy.name: Void Serpent
enemy.weakness: Celestial Key (disables its energy shield)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing gravitational fields (momentarily teleports player to random points in the chamber)

pickup.name: Stellar Shard
pickup.effect: Permanent upgrade to Voidbinder Bow: +25% damage, +15% critical chance

encounters.trigger: The Celestial Key's activation causes the Void Serpent to emerge from the core, its shield flickering. The player must time the use of the key during its shield cycle to land critical hits.

boss.name: Void Serpent
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Void Serpent while its shield is down, using the Celestial Key to trigger a core overload.

level.objective: Navigate the derelict station, retrieve the Celestial Key, and destroy the Void Serpent to prevent the station's core from destabilizing.
level.reward: Stellar Shard (permanent Voidbinder Bow upgrade) and access to the next level.

level.setting: A fractured asteroid field orbiting a dying star, where ancient alien machinery and cosmic debris form eerie, floating ruins. The air hums with static, and distant whispers echo through the void.

enemy.name: Celestial Warden
enemy.weakness: Electromagnetic pulses (EMPs) from the player's Gravity Gauntlet (unmodified).

encounters.hazard: Floating debris fields that deal 25 damage per second if the player lingers.

pickup.name: Celestial Core (Fused)
pickup.effect: Unlocks the Gravity Gauntlet's 'Overclock' mode, increasing damage by 50% and temporarily disabling enemy shielding for 5 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Warden activates a hidden portal to the next zone, glowing with unstable energy.

enemy.name: Eventide Harbinger
enemy.weakness: Kinetic energy bursts (requires the Celestial Core to amplify the Gravity Gauntlet's Overclock mode).

encounters.hazard: Gravitational rifts that pull the player toward the center, dealing 30 damage per second and slowing movement by 50%.

pickup.name: Light Prism (Fractured)
pickup.effect: Channels the player's weapon energy into a focused beam, increasing damage by 30% and bypassing 20% of enemy armor.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Harbinger destabilizes the gravity well, revealing a pathway to the Void Maw and a flickering beacon toward the final boss.

enemy.name: Void Maw
enemy.weakness: Light-based attacks (requires the Light Prism to refract and intensify the Gravity Gauntlet's Overclock mode).

encounters.hazard: A corrosive void mist that drains 10% of the player's health per 10 seconds and degrades weapon efficiency.

pickup.name: Astral Anchor
pickup.effect: Permanently upgrades the Gravity Gauntlet to 'Astral Overdrive,' doubling damage against the final boss and granting immunity to void mist.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Void Maw collapses the sanctum, exposing the core of the dying star and summoning the final boss.

boss.name: Astral Devourer
boss.weakness: Astral Anchor (required to bypass the boss's adaptive shielding and trigger a fatal energy overload).
boss.victory_condition: Use the Astral Anchor to trigger a chain reaction in the boss's core, destroying it in a supernova explosion.

level.objective: Navigate the celestial ruins, upgrade your Gravity Gauntlet with pickups from each encounter, and exploit weaknesses to defeat the Astral Devourer.
level.reward: Celestial Artificer Armor (grants +25% damage, +50% shielding, and the ability to craft temporary EMP fields).

level.setting: Derelict space station orbiting a dying star, with unstable gravity fields and flickering lights.

enemy.name: Grav-Drone
enemy.weakness: Heat (plasma welder damage)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing floor panels

pickup.name: Coolant Canister
pickup.effect: Freezes enemies on contact (cold damage)

encounters.trigger: Destroying the drone unlocks a sealed door leading to the crystalline chamber.

enemy.name: Crystal Warden
enemy.weakness: Cold (Coolant Canister)

encounters.hazard: Shattering crystals that deal 10 damage on contact

pickup.name: EMP Module
pickup.effect: Disables enemy shields (single-use)

encounters.trigger: Using the EMP Module activates the station's security system, revealing the boss chamber.

boss.name: Celestial Warden
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the core by targeting its shield generator (requires EMP Module to disable shields).

level.objective: Reach the core of the station by defeating the Celestial Warden.
level.reward: Celestial Core Fragment (unlocks advanced engineering blueprints).
